spans.s: द्वैगुणिक m. An usurer who takes cent percent interest.
द्वैगुण्य n. 1. Double amount or value; 2. the possession of two out of the three qualities of nature (viz., सत्व, रजस् and तमस्).
द्वैत n. 1. Duality; 2. dualism in philosophy, i.e. the assertion of two different principles, God and the creation, (See अद्वैत); 3. name of a forest, Kir.i.1.
द्वैत-वन n. name of a forest, Kir.i.1.
द्वैत-वादिन् m. a philosopger who asserts the dvaita doctrine.
द्वैतिन् m. A philosopher who asserts the dvaita doctrine.
द्वैतीयीक a. (f. की) Second, द्वैतीयीकतया मितोऽयमगमत्तस्य प्रबंधे महाकाव्ये चारुणि नैषधीयचरिते सर्गो निसर्गोज्ज्वलः Na.ii.110. (Cf. तार्तीयीक.)
द्वैतीयीक a. (f. की) Second, द्वैतीयीकतया मितोऽयमगमत्तस्य प्रबंधे महाकाव्ये चारुणि नैषधीयचरिते सर्गो निसर्गोज्ज्वलः Na.ii.110. (Cf. तार्तीयीक.)
द्वैध (I) a. (f. धी) Twofold, double.

द्वैध (II) n. 1. Duality, duplicity; 2. disunion, diversity, contest, difference, श्रुतिद्वैधं तु यत्र स्यात् M.ii.14; 3. doubt, uncertainty; 4. double-dealing, one of the six modes of foreign policy. See द्वैधीभाव below and आसन (5).
द्वैध (I) a. (f. धी) Twofold, double.

द्वैधीभाव m. 1. Duplicity, double nature; 2. difference; 3. doubt, uncertainty; 4. one of the six military tactics (गुण q.v.) or courses. According to some, it consists in dividing one’s army and opposing the enemy in parts somewhat after the mode of guerilla warfare, M.vii.160, 173. According to others, it means ‘keeping friendly attitude with all or with two hostile powers,’ ‘a kind of double-dealing or duplicity.’ See Mall. on Sis.ii.56.
द्वैप (I) a. (f. पी) 1. Relating to an island; 2. belonging to a tiger.
द्वैप (II) m. A car covered with a tiger’s skin.
द्वैप (I) a. (f. पी) 1. Relating to an island; 2. belonging to a tiger.
द्वैपक्ष n. Two parties.
द्वैपायन m. (the island-born) An epithet of Vyāsa. See क्रुष्णद्वैपायन.
द्वैप्य (I) a. (f. प्या or प्यी) Relating to an island.
द्वैप्य (II) m. An islander, Sis.iii.76.
द्वैप्य (I) a. (f. प्या or प्यी) Relating to an island.
द्वैप्य (I) a. (f. प्या or प्यी) Relating to an island.
द्वैमातुर m. 1. An epithet of Gaṇeśa; 2. of Jarāsandha, Sis.ii.60.
द्वैमातृक a. (f. की) Nourished by rain and rivers (as a country). See देवमातृक.
द्वैमातृक a. (f. की) Nourished by rain and rivers (as a country). See देवमातृक.
द्वैरथ (I) n. A single combat in chariots.
द्वैरथ (II) m. An adversary.
द्वैराज्य n. A dominion divided between two kings.
द्वैविध्य n. 1. Duality, two fold nature; 2. difference, diversity.
